BOT_ID.description: Optional bot-network identifier; used only when NETWORK_BOT_ID is not set

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection URI; store as a secret

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Bot owner WhatsApp number in international digits

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Optional WhatsApp number in international digits for pairing-code login

PAIRING_PAGE_PASSWORD.description: Private pairing-page password; at least 16 characters to use pairing-code login

PORT.description: Web server port (normally assigned by the hosting platform)

WA_AUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Dedicated 32-byte key for encrypted MongoDB WhatsApp auth snapshots; store as a secret and back it up securely
